linkedin.text:
mdEditor 1.0.15: Simplified Chinese, clipboard capture, and an improved startup.

I updated my free Windows Markdown editor and recorded new Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese demonstrations.

New: a Chinese interface and samples, optional new-document-from-clipboard shortcut, and startup improvements. The clipboard shortcut is created only after confirmation in Settings; startup performance depends on your PC.

The established strengths remain: live preview and synchronized scrolling, offline Mermaid/Graphviz/math, interactive STL models, maps, image drag-and-drop with size and alignment controls, and PDF/Word/ZIP sharing.

No ads, no tracking, no account. Internet media and detailed maps load only with permission. Word import does not preserve colors or layout.

English: https://5garashi.github.io/mdEditor/en.html
日本語: https://5garashi.github.io/mdEditor/
简体中文: https://5garashi.github.io/mdEditor/zh-CN.html

簡体字中国語・クリップボード新規作成・起動改善に加え、従来の図・数式・3D・PDFの強みも紹介しています。
